title: review findings
description: The shape every reviewer axis returns, whether the review runs through the Claude `full-review` workflow or the Codex `codex exec --output-schema` path. One file, so the two paths cannot produce different finding shapes: an empty `findings` list is a valid and common result, and a finding carries the fields the synthesiser merges on. Extracted from `workflows/full-review.js` so the factory can hand the same schema to `codex exec --output-schema` without re-authoring it in Python. Written to the structured-output subset both paths accept: every object sets `additionalProperties: false` and lists every property in `required`, because the Codex path sends this as a strict response format and the API rejects anything else. A field that is genuinely optional is therefore required-and-nullable, not absent.

file.description: The file the defect is in, as a repo-relative path.

line.description: The 1-based line the defect anchors to, or null when it anchors to no single line.

severity.description: How bad the defect is, in the four tiers the synthesiser ranks by.

why_it_matters.description: One sentence on the consequence, for a reader who cannot see the code; null when the summary says it all.

findings.description: Every real defect this axis found in the diff. An empty list is valid and common.
